findings.finding: The baseline described all three supported comparisons but generated different comparison IDs, so the frozen exact-contract audit did not recognize them.
The baseline explicitly abstained from a club performance trend in its headline and recommendation, but it did not emit the canonical insufficient comparison object required by the frozen contract.
The baseline preserved a non-causal boundary for the high-wind Atlas outing but used its own comparison ID and CONFLICTED status rather than the canonical ID and INSUFFICIENT status.
The baseline routed both verified deviations to coach priorities with their evidence references, while the frozen audit required them in recommendations.

review_note: The frozen 7/7 versus 3/7 audit remains valid evidence of machine-stable contract fidelity. Because the direct baseline surfaced much of the same coaching content in different IDs, statuses, or sections, the audit is not accepted as a semantic coaching-quality score and was not rescored after output review.
